purpose: Convert the candidate standard Iwasawa deck generators into explicit scalar mode admissibility equations for the Galerkin basis, while keeping MTT lattice selection, bundle transitions, and selected modes open.

central_character_decomposition.central_lattice_condition: g5 and g6 force k1,k2 to be integers

nonzero_central_sectors.label: k != (0,0)
nonzero_central_sectors.required_basis_type: theta/magnetic or finite-element functions satisfying the twisted base conditions
nonzero_central_sectors.reason: x1 and x2 shifts carry y-dependent phase multipliers

finite_basis_implication.spectral_route: Choose finite central labels k and, for each k, functions F_k,n satisfying the twisted base conditions; only k=(0,0) admits ordinary T4 Fourier modes.
finite_basis_implication.finite_element_route: On the unit six-cell, impose g1..g6 boundary identifications directly; after central decomposition, impose the above twisted four-dimensional boundary constraints for each k.
finite_basis_implication.bundle_route: A bundle-valued basis must combine these scalar constraints with s(gamma*z)=rho_E(gamma,z)s(z).

verdict.next_step: Either select a finite central-label/basis family satisfying the filter, or instantiate finite-element constraints on the six-cell, then combine with rho_E and selected D_E.
